target: data-retrieval: M0 data pipeline, M14-M16 ppRAG phases, M18 retrieval accuracy

verdict.summary: All five gates re-run independently and observed PASS (M0 15/15, M14 12/12, M15 11/11, M16 11/11, M18 19/19). exp2's headline numbers were reproduced with an independent implementation: CAPRISE k'=k recall@10 vs plaintext = 0.9704 (reported 0.9699), plaintext qrels MRR@10 = 0.722997 (reported 0.7230), CAPRISE+DP(r=0.02) k' = ceil(71.025370) = 72 (reported k'=72, fixed radius) with recall 1.0000 (reported 1.0000), ADCPE k'=k recall 0.9746 (reported 0.9724). Data integrity and corpus composition fully match notes/data_manifest.md (1000 eval qids, m=50000, sources 1053/18544/30403, qrels 1080 pairs all in corpus, 100% eval coverage). No fabricated/hidden-shrinkage/plaintext-substitution issues found: 0 issues affecting measured values or conclusions. Minor issues are gate strength/notes-accuracy items only.

environment.note: shared Apple M5; co-running teammate jobs (load average ~4-5) inflate absolute latencies; timings below are reported as observed.
environment.data: data/ (m=50000 MS MARCO passages, 1000 dev queries, gtr-t5-base 768-d L2)

gate_reruns.key_output: real data m=8000 (all 1053 qrels passages in prefix); server has no CryptoKey/plaintext; 8000 unique 16B nonces; DecDB roundtrip 9.47e-9; 0 noise-bound violations
k'=k recall 0.9630 (m=8000, 100 q, fresh nonces); k'=20 recall 1.0; DP r=0.02 k'=55==ceil(Theorem1(10,8000,768,0.02)); server.search spy: q' (d=768), ||q'||=3.0035 vs s||q||=3.0012
prompt exact template, 10/10 docs in order, no leaks, 20/20 batch prompts ok
artifact-based verification of results/exp2_retrieval.json: 11 configs, CAPRISE k'=k 0.9699, DP r=0.02 k'=72/recall 1.0, beta monotone 0.9910/0.9854/0.9699/0.9401

independent_recompute.method: Own code, no import of experiments/exp2_retrieval.py or its helpers; only src/caprise core primitives (KeyGen/EncDB/EncQ/DecDB_one/EncryptedVectorDB/distance_dp/theorem.k_prime) and data/*.npy. 1000 queries, k=10, m=50000, s=3, beta=0.2.

caprise_kp_eq_k.note: difference within nonce-randomness/MC noise (per-query flip floor ~0.03 => sigma ~0.005); reproduces the reported value.

caprise_dp_r002.exp2_k_prime_interpretation: FIXED radius r=0.02 (dp_radius float) -> ceil(Theorem1) constant for every query; NOT per-query gamma sampling (correcting the reviewer brief's assumption).

gamma_sampled_alternative.protocol: if r ~ Gamma(shape=768, scale=0.02/768) per query (mean 0.02)
gamma_sampled_alternative.conclusion: average would still be ~72, so the reported k'=72 is self-consistent under either convention; the implementation itself uses the fixed-radius convention.

caprise_dp_r002.note: DP recall = 1.0 is expected because k'=72 is a sufficient (and deliberately loose, see M13/F9) Theorem-1 bound; it is not an independent accuracy gain.

adcpe_kp_eq_k.note: same ordering as exp2: ADCPE slightly above CAPRISE (CAPRISE uses larger DB noise 3sB/8 vs sB/4).

latency_spot_check.conclusion: absolute latencies are load-sensitive on this shared machine (own measurements 2-4x slower under load ~4.8); the relative claim (encrypted pipeline <=2x plaintext, server search dominates) is consistent with the same-run measurements. Cannot reproduce absolute milliseconds bit-for-bit.

data_integrity.note: L2 deviation ~4.9e-4 comes from MPS fp16 encoding and is documented in notes/data_manifest.md §3 (M0 gate tolerance 1e-3 is set accordingly).

m15_server_input_check.question: does the M15 gate actually inspect the arguments passed to server.search (not just logs)?
m15_server_input_check.mechanism_found: gates/gate_m15_phase2.py monkeypatches server.db.search with _spy_search(q_prime, k) that copies the real q_prime ndarray and the k argument, so it records ACTUAL call arguments.

verified_by_verifier.own_spy_run: own PPRAGServer/Client on m=2000 real data, own wrapper around server.db.search

m15_server_input_check.gate_06_strength: checks shape(768), not-equal to plaintext, not-equal to s*plaintext, and ||q'|| within s*beta/8 of s*||q|| for the FIRST call -> content-level check is real but single-sample.
m15_server_input_check.gate_07_strength: only asserts shape==(768,) for all 300 calls and the call count; it does NOT verify ciphertext-ness/content per call (the wording 'all with a (d,) ciphertext query' overstates what is asserted).
m15_server_input_check.gate_04_strength: compares the CLIENT-reported k' (res.k_prime_requested) to ceil(Theorem1); the server-observed k in the spy record is stored but never asserted.
m15_server_input_check.verdict: the gate does check real server.search inputs (not logs), but two assertions are weaker than their wording: (a) all-call check is shape-only; (b) server-side k' not cross-checked. Recommend tightening (see issue V-M15-1).

findings: real data m=50000/nq=1000 loaded from data/ (no hidden subsetting; default args run full scale, command recorded in meta).

encrypted pipelines use PPRAGClient/PPRAGServer: server-side search runs on ciphertext E' and q' (EncryptedVectorDB); plaintext distances are used ONLY client-side for re-ranking, as declared in SPEC §3 - not a hidden substitution.
CAPRISE k'=k path passes k_prime=None and dp_radius=0 -> k'=k (no oversampling leak).
DP path uses fixed r=0.02/0.05 and k'=ceil(theorem.k_prime); pprag re-derives k' from r_used, so exp2's precomputed value matches (verified in JSON: k_prime_set=[72]/[785]).
recall@10 metric = |encrypted top-10 ∩ plaintext top-10|/10; qrels MRR@10 = mean 1/rank of first relevant among top-10 - consistent with docs/CLAIMS_CHECKLIST.md section '统计口径说明'.
no hardcoded expected metric values; result JSON written from measured arrays; fresh 128-bit nonces documented.
reads stored artifacts and validates scale/configs/metric ranges; no tampering with exp2 code.
thresholds are loose (see issues): recall k'=k >=0.90 (measured 0.9699), k'=2k >=0.99 (1.0), DP recall >=0.99 (1.0), plaintext qrels MRR in [0.2,0.9] (0.723), latency <=2x plaintext.

check 10 compares exp2's k_prime_mean with meta theorem_k_prime computed by the SAME theorem function inside exp2 (consistency, not independent validation); Theorem 1 itself is independently gated by M13/exp5.
spy-based server.search argument inspection (real args, see m15_server_input_check).
uses m=8000 real prefix (contains all 1053 qrels passages per data_manifest order); declared in check 00.
recall thresholds 0.70 (k'=k) / 0.80 (DP) are loose vs measured 0.9630 / 1.0.
DP k'=55 for m=8000 consistent: ceil(k_prime(10,8000,768,0.02))=55.
validates files/npys/meta consistency/NaN/L2 norm/row counts/ids/qrels coverage/sanity retrieval; thresholds documented in comments.
L2 normalization tolerance 1e-3 is required because embeddings were encoded in fp16 on MPS (actual 4.87e-4); documented in notes/data_manifest.md §3.
qrels coverage 100% and MRR 0.7219 are re-computed by the gate itself (not copied from notes).
M14 checks server holds only protocol fields, no CryptoKey, ciphertext-only DB, unique 128-bit nonces, roundtrips, strict noise bound, id preservation.
M16 checks exact prompt template/order/no leakage/batch/empty context.
M14 check 'no plaintext documents on server' scans only the first 200 of 8000 documents (sampling; see issue).
data sources official MS MARCO; corpus = qrels-relevant (1053) + BM25 hard negatives (18544) + deterministic random fill (30403), order documented and verified (first 1053 rows all source=qrels).

the BM25-hard-negative augmentation deviates from the original task-1 'random fill only' spec; it is explicitly disclosed in data_manifest.md (with random-fill-only control MRR=0.9486) and was approved by the Lead; recorded as disclosed deviation (F13), not a defect.
embeddings fp16 MPS + float32 storage; query/passage same model/precision; norms match gate.
CSV rows=11=configs; JSON/notes numbers consistent (upload 0.7129 s / 70140 vec/s, k' values, recalls, MRR spread 0.7230+-0.0002).
notes accurately declare: paper gives no retrieval table; m=50k vs paper Table III m=100k; Delta-alpha=r convention; re-rank = exact plaintext distance (upper bound).
minor notes inaccuracy: notes §4 cites m=8000 gate recall 0.959, current M15 gate run reports 0.9630 (fresh nonces each gate run); should say '~0.96, nonce-dependent'.

issues.issue: The reviewer brief suggested exp2 averages k' over per-query sampled DP radii. In fact exp2 uses a FIXED radius r=0.02 (pprag passes dp_radius=0.02 float), so k' is constant 72 for every query (JSON k_prime_set=[72]).
issues.impact: none on numbers: a hypothetical Gamma(mean 0.02) radius would give E[ceil(k')]~71.68, i.e. also ~72; conclusion unchanged.
issues.recommendation: notes/exp2_retrieval.md should state explicitly 'fixed-radius k'=72 per query' to prevent mis-reading.

issues.issue: check 07 wording ('all with a (d,) ciphertext query') only asserts shape/​count for the 300 calls; content-level ciphertext check is done for 1 call (check 06). check 04 asserts the CLIENT-reported k', while the server-observed k recorded by the spy is never asserted.
issues.impact: no false PASS of the current implementation (verified independently), but the gate would not catch a hypothetical implementation that transmits plaintext for calls 2..300 or requests a different k at the server.
issues.recommendation: assert per-call content invariants on the spy records (norm in [s||q||-sβ/8, s||q||+sβ/8], not allclose to q/s*q) and compare spy k values to ceil(Theorem1).

issues.issue: thresholds are loose: rec_k>=0.90 (measured 0.9699), plaintext MRR in [0.2,0.9] (0.723), DP/oversampling recall>=0.99, 2k>=0.99, MRR delta<=0.01.
issues.impact: would tolerate sizable degradation (e.g. recall 0.91) without failing; current data passes with big margin so no false PASS.
issues.recommendation: tighten to measured values with margin, e.g. rec_k>=0.95, rec_2k>=0.999, DP recall>=0.999, plaintext MRR in [0.65,0.80].

issues.issue: exp2 k' vs 'expected' k' is computed by the same theorem.k_prime() call inside exp2 (self-consistency only).
issues.impact: does not independently validate Theorem 1; acceptable because Theorem 1 is separately validated in M13 (exp5) and by the separate cross-review (verify_theory).
issues.recommendation: add a note in the gate docstring pointing to M13/verify_theory for theorem validation.

issues.issue: 'no plaintext documents on server' scans the first 200 of 8000 AES ciphertexts.
issues.impact: sample-based check; AES-GCM blobs are mac'd so a leak is very unlikely, but the assertion is not exhaustive.
issues.recommendation: scan all m documents (cheap: 8000 x substring test) or state the sampling explicitly.

issues.issue: Absolute latency numbers (plaintext 2.45 ms/q, encrypted 2.35 ms/q, upload 0.71 s) are reproducible only qualitatively on this shared machine; under co-running jobs our independent latency measurements were 2-4x slower.
issues.impact: the reported within-run comparison (encrypted <=2x plaintext; server search dominates) is consistent and honest; absolute ms cannot be cross-session validated.
issues.recommendation: notes should mark latency as load-sensitive (like M17 did) and prefer ratios.

issues.issue: (a) notes §4 cites M15 m=8000 recall 0.959 while the current gate run reports 0.9630 (fresh nonces per run) - should be '~0.96'; (b) corpus includes 18544 BM25 hard negatives vs task-1 'random fill' spec - disclosed in data_manifest.md (with random-fill-only control MRR 0.9486) and approved by Lead.
issues.impact: none on verdict; both are transparency items.
issues.recommendation: (a) quote a range or mark nonce-dependent; (b) keep the deviation note in the final report (already F13 in docs/FINDINGS.md).
